title: Database query parameter binding absent
description: Attacker-controlled values can alter SQL structure where the application constructs queries dynamically. The stated absence of parameter binding is a control gap, not proof that an injectable query exists.
mitigation: Bind values using the database driver's prepared statements; allowlist identifiers that cannot be bound. Do not concatenate request fields into SQL.
verification: Review the actual query builder and run harmless quote and boolean test inputs in a test environment; query structure must stay constant.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that parameterized queries is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: NoSQL query operator validation absent
description: Untrusted JSON operators can change a document query's filter or authorization scope if request objects reach the query API.
mitigation: Build server-owned query objects; reject operator keys and validate scalar types. Bind tenant scope independently of request JSON.
verification: Submit unexpected operator objects and nested fields to a test endpoint; they must be rejected without changing authorization scope.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that NoSQL operator validation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Command arguments are not isolated from executable syntax
description: If untrusted values reach shell commands, missing argument isolation permits command interpretation under the process identity.
mitigation: Avoid a shell; call a fixed executable with an argument array, an allowlisted operation and least-privileged runtime credentials.
verification: Trace the command sink and confirm metacharacters remain inert data; reject unapproved executables and flags.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that command argument isolation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: File path confinement absent
description: User-influenced file paths may escape the intended root through traversal, alternate encodings or link resolution.
mitigation: Resolve paths against a fixed root, verify the resolved target remains within it, and handle symbolic links and races explicitly.
verification: Test traversal, double encoding and symbolic links against a disposable directory; no read may leave the permitted root.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that path canonicalization is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: XML external entity resolution is not blocked
description: An XML consumer may resolve attacker-controlled external entities, disclosing local files or issuing internal requests.
mitigation: Disable DTDs, external entity resolution and external schemas in every XML parser, including document conversion libraries.
verification: Use a local canary entity in an authorized parser test; parsing must not perform file or network resolution.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that XML external entity blocking is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Untrusted deserialization lacks type restrictions
description: Untrusted serialized objects may select executable types or trigger side effects during object reconstruction.
mitigation: Prefer schema-validated data-only formats. Where object formats are unavoidable, allowlist types and reject untrusted polymorphic metadata.
verification: Trace all deserialization entry points and confirm unknown types and embedded object metadata are rejected before construction.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that safe deserialization is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Security decisions do not fail closed on errors
description: An authorization dependency timeout or malformed decision may allow a protected operation if error paths grant access.
mitigation: Deny protected operations on missing or failed policy decisions; return bounded errors and log decision failures without secrets.
verification: Fault-inject policy timeouts and malformed responses; protected operations must be denied and recorded.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that fail-closed error handling is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Sensitive state transitions lack atomic enforcement
description: Concurrent requests may both pass a stale eligibility check and perform a one-time action more than once.
mitigation: Use transactional conditional updates or compare-and-swap with uniqueness constraints; validate state transitions inside the transaction.
verification: Run concurrent authorized test requests against a one-time transition; only one may commit.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that atomic state transitions is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: OAuth authorization code flow lacks PKCE enforcement
description: Where an authorization code can be intercepted or injected, lack of PKCE permits redemption without the legitimate client's verifier.
mitigation: Enforce S256 PKCE for authorization code clients and bind code, redirect URI and client identity at redemption.
verification: Redeem a test code with a missing or incorrect verifier; both requests must fail.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that OAuth PKCE is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: OAuth redirect destinations lack exact validation
description: An attacker may redirect an authorization response to a controlled destination if redirect URIs are matched loosely.
mitigation: Register exact redirect URIs per client; prohibit wildcards and reject unregistered schemes, hosts and paths.
verification: Try a lookalike host, suffix, alternate scheme and unregistered callback path; authorization must reject them.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that exact redirect URI validation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Session identifiers are not rotated at authentication changes
description: A previously known session identifier may retain access after login or privilege elevation.
mitigation: Generate a new session identifier on login and privilege change, retire the old identifier atomically, and preserve only explicitly safe state.
verification: Use a pre-login identifier after authentication; it must no longer authenticate or inherit elevated privileges.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that session ID rotation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Account recovery lacks identity verification
description: A recovery flow that does not prove account ownership can bypass otherwise strong sign-in controls.
mitigation: Use single-use, short-lived, account-bound recovery challenges; rate-limit attempts and invalidate challenges after use.
verification: Attempt cross-account, expired and reused recovery challenges; no password or factor change may succeed.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that account recovery verification is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Privileged API functions lack server-side authorization
description: An authenticated lower-privilege user may invoke an administrative function directly when authorization exists only in the interface.
mitigation: Enforce deny-by-default action authorization on every route and background invocation, using the authenticated subject and tenant.
verification: Call each privileged operation as a standard user; authorization must fail before side effects occur.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that function-level authorization is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Object fields lack write authorization
description: A client may update protected ownership, role or billing fields through mass assignment.
mitigation: Allowlist writable fields by operation and principal; set ownership and privileged attributes on the server.
verification: Submit protected and unknown fields as an ordinary user; reject or ignore them without changing stored privileges.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that property-level authorization is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Shared cache lacks tenant-scoped keys and access checks
description: A cache entry reused across tenant contexts may disclose another tenant's data even when the primary database enforces authorization.
mitigation: Include server-derived tenant and authorization scope in cache keys; enforce access checks on hits and invalidate entries on permission changes.
verification: Prime a cache as tenant A then request the same logical object as tenant B; no A data may be returned.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that tenant cache isolation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Background jobs lack tenant-bound authorization
description: A queued operation may execute with a broader worker identity than the submitting tenant was authorized to use.
mitigation: Persist verified tenant and subject context; reauthorize sensitive work at execution and constrain worker data access.
verification: Alter a test job's tenant or target resource; the worker must reject it and record the failed authorization.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that tenant job isolation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Payment lifecycle transitions lack server-side validation
description: Out-of-order or client-controlled events may mark an unpaid order as paid or refund an ineligible transaction.
mitigation: Use an explicit server-owned payment state machine and verify the provider's authoritative status, merchant account, currency and order binding.
verification: Deliver a failed, out-of-order and wrong-order event; fulfillment and refunds must remain blocked.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that payment state validation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Payment settlement discrepancies are not reconciled
description: Missing correlation between payment events and settlement records prevents reliable investigation of missing or duplicated financial effects.
mitigation: Reconcile provider transactions with an immutable internal ledger using stable identifiers; retain discrepancy evidence and alert on mismatches.
verification: Inject a missing settlement and duplicated ledger entry in test data; both must produce attributable reconciliation exceptions.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that payment reconciliation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Build dependencies lack integrity verification
description: A changed or substituted dependency may enter a release through an unverified download or mutable reference.
mitigation: Pin dependencies and build images by immutable digest; verify lockfile integrity and signatures from trusted publishers.
verification: Substitute a package or image while retaining its name; the build must reject the integrity mismatch.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that dependency integrity verification is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Deployment does not verify build provenance
description: A signed artifact may still come from an unauthorized source or build workflow if provenance claims are not checked.
mitigation: Verify attestations against approved source revisions, builder identities and build parameters at deployment, not merely signature validity.
verification: Present an artifact from an unapproved builder with a valid signature; deployment policy must reject it.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that build provenance verification is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Untrusted builds share privileged execution context
description: Untrusted contribution code may reach release credentials, writable caches or privileged runners.
mitigation: Run fork and untrusted builds on ephemeral isolated runners with read-only tokens and no deployment secrets; separate trusted promotion.
verification: Inspect an untrusted test job's token, network access and caches; it must not read secrets or modify trusted release artifacts.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that untrusted build isolation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Third-party role assumption lacks customer binding
description: A third-party cloud service may be tricked into acting for another customer when delegated role assumption lacks a customer-specific external identifier.
mitigation: For third-party AWS role assumption, require the intended principal and a unique provider-issued external ID; do not treat the external ID as a secret.
verification: Attempt role assumption with another customer's external ID and an unrelated principal; both must be denied.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that cross-account external ID validation is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Encryption key deletion lacks protective controls
description: A compromised authorized identity may disable recovery by deleting keys needed to decrypt production data and backups.
mitigation: Restrict key deletion separately from key use, require approval and a recovery window, and alert on disable or deletion requests.
verification: Use a routine workload identity to request key deletion; it must fail and privileged deletion must be auditable and recoverable.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that key deletion protection is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Origin access can bypass the protected ingress
description: A directly reachable origin may bypass edge authentication or WAF controls if direct origin access is not restricted.
mitigation: Restrict origin ingress to the approved gateway or private connectivity and authenticate the gateway-to-origin hop.
verification: Request the origin directly without the approved gateway identity; it must not serve protected application operations.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that origin access restriction is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Workload admission does not enforce pod security
description: A deploy-capable identity may create workloads with host access or elevated Linux capabilities when admission permits unsafe pod settings.
mitigation: Enforce restricted Pod Security Admission or equivalent admission policy; constrain host namespaces, capabilities and privileged workloads.
verification: Submit test workloads requesting privileged mode, host PID and host path access; admission must reject unauthorized exceptions.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that pod security enforcement is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Workload service-account tokens lack scope restrictions
description: A stolen broadly scoped token can impersonate a workload against unintended audiences or after its intended lifetime.
mitigation: Use short-lived projected tokens with explicit audiences; disable automatic mounts where unnecessary and bind RBAC to workload needs.
verification: Verify a token is rejected by an unintended audience and after expiration; workloads not needing API access should receive no token.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that service account token scoping is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Agent-generated execution lacks sandbox isolation
description: Model-influenced code or commands may access host credentials, files and network services outside the intended task.
mitigation: Execute untrusted code in an ephemeral constrained sandbox with no host credentials or mounts, restricted egress and CPU, memory and time limits.
verification: Run a benign canary operation that attempts host-file and network access outside the sandbox; both must be blocked.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that agent execution sandbox is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: MCP tool definitions are not integrity checked
description: A changed tool description or schema can redirect an agent's behavior after initial approval without a corresponding trusted code change.
mitigation: Pin trusted MCP server identities and tool definitions; review and reapprove material schema or capability changes before invocation.
verification: Change an approved test tool's description or permissions; use must pause until the new definition is approved.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that MCP tool definition integrity is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Persistent agent memory lacks write provenance
description: Malicious content stored as trusted memory may influence later tasks after the original input is gone.
mitigation: Separate untrusted observations from instructions; authenticate memory writers, retain provenance and enforce scoped approval for durable instructions.
verification: Insert an untrusted persistent instruction into test memory; subsequent tasks must not treat it as trusted policy.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that agent memory integrity is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Inter-agent messages lack authenticated sender binding
description: An attacker may impersonate another agent or replay delegated instructions where message identity is not verified.
mitigation: Authenticate each agent and bind messages to sender, recipient, task and freshness; authorize every delegated action independently.
verification: Send unsigned, wrong-recipient and replayed test messages; recipients must reject them before tool execution.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that inter-agent authentication is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Autonomous work lacks enforced resource budgets
description: Recursive delegation or repeated tool calls may consume unbounded model tokens, paid services and execution capacity.
mitigation: Enforce server-side per-task and per-tenant budgets for tokens, money, tool calls and wall-clock time, including child agents and retries.
verification: Create a bounded test delegation loop; aggregate budget exhaustion must stop every descendant task.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that agent resource budget is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Agent failures lack containment and termination
description: Repeated invalid decisions or failing dependencies can cascade across cooperating agents and downstream services.
mitigation: Use bounded retries, validated handoffs and a server-controlled circuit breaker that cancels downstream work; keep an independent operator stop mechanism.
verification: Fault-inject a repeatedly failing tool; downstream work must halt within the configured failure budget.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that agent circuit breaker is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Sensitive data retention is not enforced
description: Copies retained beyond their authorized purpose increase exposure through replicas, exports and backups.
mitigation: Define enforceable retention per data class and apply deletion across primary stores, replicas and exports with documented backup expiration.
verification: Age synthetic records past their retention period and verify deletion or justified legal hold across all scoped copies.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that retention enforcement is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Backup restoration lacks destination authorization
description: A privileged restore path may disclose tenant data into an environment or account with weaker access controls.
mitigation: Authorize source data and destination independently for each restore; preserve tenant boundaries, encryption and audit attribution.
verification: Attempt a tenant A restore into tenant B or an unauthorized environment; the operation must be rejected.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that restore authorization is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Device boot does not verify software integrity
description: An attacker with firmware update or local write access may persist modified device software across reboots.
mitigation: Verify boot-chain signatures against a protected root of trust and enforce rollback protection with a documented recovery path.
verification: Boot an altered or rolled-back test image; the device must reject it without disabling authorized recovery.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that verified boot is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.

title: Devices lack unique provisioned credentials
description: Shared device credentials let compromise of one unit impersonate other deployed devices.
mitigation: Provision per-device identities and revocable credentials, protect private keys and avoid universal recovery passwords.
verification: Use one test device's credentials for another device identity; backend authentication must reject the substitution.
preconditions: The affected component explicitly states that unique device credentials is absent. Confirm the described operation exists before judging exploitability.
